descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S19 「医生感受到的 Save Note：从点按到面板更新，10 轮（5 个医院 + 5 个养老院），每次调用记下 AI 自己的时间和模型」 Save Note as the physician feels it: tap to panels updated, 10 cycles (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home), with the AI's own time and model per call

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 Save Note timing: panels within 10-15 s, 15 s or less in at least 9/10 cycles (a target, not pass/fail; a run over 30 s not caused by the AI service is investigated). …（UAT 3.5；UAT 3.9）
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given A fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; per cycle a fresh Hospital patient (age 72, Community-acquired pneumonia) or Nursing Home resident (Post-acute rehab after hip fracture); the local model

When Each cycle types the S01 (Hospital) or S02 (Nursing Home) text, taps Save Note and waits until 'Auto-updated:' (both modes' success message) or the summary-failed error is visible

Then Each cycle's time from the Save Note click to the visible result is recorded, with each AI call's model, fellBackFrom, durationMs and providerMs from diagnostics:list (parsing.parsePreRoundNotes, parsing.classifyAdmissionReason, parsing.extractTasks); the count at or under 15 s out of 10 and every cycle over 30 s are listed

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Recorded, not Pass/Fail (3.5 'timings are targets'): the runner writes status 'unknown' (to-allure shows needs-human) with the count ≤ 15 s of 10, the cycles > 30 s, and model, fellBackFrom and providerMs per call so a slow cycle can be told apart from a slow model. …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-b。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-b。

Every call claude-haiku-4-5, no fellBackFrom, providerMs within a few ms of durationMs. Machine load average 25–60 during the run (other jobs, unrelated workloads).
